name: Carmel Valley Ranch
positioning: All-suite resort on 500 acres in the Santa Lucia foothills of Carmel Valley, with a Pete Dye golf course, its own vineyard, garden, goats and bees
best_for: Active travelers who like being outdoors
Families who want kids' programs and farm-animal encounters

facts.text: Carmel Valley Ranch is a resort set on 500 acres in California.
The resort sits in the foothills of Monterey's Santa Lucia Mountains, about eight miles inland from the Pacific Ocean.
Suites have fireplaces, private decks and spa-inspired bathrooms with aromatherapy amenities.
Golf holes range from riverside par-3s to par-5s winding into the foothills of the Santa Lucias.
The resort has a four-acre working vineyard.
Spa Aiyana's facilities include a saltwater pool, an infinity hot tub, locker rooms with eucalyptus steam and a co-ed warming room.
River Ranch, the main activity hub, has the Family Pool, a children's wading pool and splash pad, tennis and pickleball courts, and an adult pool.
The Adventure Den offers activities for children aged 2 to 12, with a new theme each day of the week.
Daily activities range from guided hikes and yoga to archery lessons and picnics with a pair of resident miniature donkeys.
Dogs are welcome, with a special program that includes a bed, treats and pooch room service.
Swaths of lavender bloom on the grounds every summer and are used in the custom-made toiletries.
Signature restaurant Valley Kitchen showcases fresh, local ingredients, many of them grown or produced at the resort.

highlights.text: Resident artisans craft cheese with milk from the ranch's own goats, grow grapes for its own wines and press oil from its own olives.
The golf course is a Pete Dye-designed bentgrass layout.
Every room at the resort is a suite.
Spa Aiyana has 12 treatment rooms and suites, most with private outdoor terraces.
A two-acre organic garden and orchard grows fruits, vegetables, flowers and herbs for the resort's kitchens, and guests can suit up and step into its apiary.

considerations.text: The property is spread out and paths can be hilly, though they are paved.
Room views vary from the valley and golf course to vineyards and oak trees, some filtering a view of the Lodge and its parking lot, so choose carefully when booking.
All spa facilities are designed for adult use, and the minimum age for massages is 18.
